# uplapse Provider

Manage [Uplapse](https://uplapse.com) uptime monitors as code.

Authenticate with an organisation API key (Settings > API keys in the app). Creating, changing and deleting monitors needs a key with the `OWNER`, `DOMAIN_ADMIN` or `EDITOR` role; reading needs any role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    uplapse = {
      source  = "uplapse/uplapse"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# The API key is best passed through the UPLAPSE_API_KEY environment variable.
provider "uplapse" {
  # api_key  = var.uplapse_api_key
  # endpoint = "https://api.uplapse.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Uplapse API key (`upm_...`). May also be set with the `UPLAPSE_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the Uplapse API. Defaults to `https://api.uplapse.com`; may also be set with the `UPLAPSE_ENDPOINT` environment variable.
